component.name: Cue
component.summary: Write notes and turn them into timely reminders

description.p: Cue is a focused scratchpad for quick notes and one-time reminders. Write directly on the canvas, then add an English schedule such as “@tomorrow 9am” when a note should notify you.
Notes and reminders stay on your device. Complete or snooze reminders from the notification, review upcoming reminders by day, and keep a local history of completed items.

screenshot.caption: Write notes and schedule reminders on the same canvas

description.p: Initial release with a local note canvas, reminders, snoozing, and history.
